blocks.text: This Christmas season, NUSTAR Resort Cebu is turning a longstanding holiday tradition into an opportunity to make a difference through Christmas Village of Love Cebu, an initiative that brings the community together in support of children and families facing serious health challenges. Now part of Your Holiday Village at NUSTAR, the charitable attraction offers guests more than a festive display of miniature houses and landmarks. Through its Adopt-A-Village initiative, the resort provides a platform for individuals, families, and organizations to contribute to causes that extend beyond the holiday season.
